name: doubao-skin-library

themeList.mobileBehavior: hide column labels and type; reduce preview; keep view action visible

alignment: Title, search, result count, column labels and theme rows share the same left and right bounds.
Theme thumbnails, names, type labels and actions each share a stable column edge.
Desktop uses exactly one 264px left sidebar; it becomes a compact top bar below 920px.
Type and series filters appear only in the navigation surface and combine with AND semantics.
Guide and contribution prose stays within a 760px reading column.
The list remains open; no outer card or card grid is introduced.
